payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans string left to right, checking for triples with step ≤9. Maintains pointer x to the last triple's start; counts intervals containing any triple using (start_diff)*(remaining_endings). O(n) time.
payload.rationale: Uses a two-pointer-like approach: end pointer i advances, start pointer x updates when a valid triple is found, efficiently counting intervals without enumerating all. Fixed step range ensures constant inner loop.
